protocol.universe_policy: Fixed present-day survivors; conclusions apply only to this basket, with survivorship/selection bias
protocol.data_source: Yahoo chart snapshot as a provisional research source; replaceable with explicit-action CSV
protocol.execution: Daily target rebalance at next session open; long only; no borrowing; sell before buying; proportional allocation of shared cash
protocol.corporate_actions: As-traded OHLC; explicit splits; ex-date distributions segregated and never reinvested; no use of unknown payment dates
protocol.benchmark: Equal-weight buy-and-hold of the same five stocks; identical initial capital and transaction costs; distributions not reinvested
protocol.evaluation: Fixed rules without parameter optimization; each period resets capital and positions, using earlier bars only for signal warmup
protocol.holdout_policy: Freeze code, protocol and snapshot hashes before evaluation; never select parameters from holdout results
protocol.confirmed_in_chat: 2026-10-15: five-stock starter universe and period split accepted; provisional public data source to be revisited later
